mechanism: Prednisolone (systemic absorption from ophthalmic formulation) may potentiate the hypertensive effects of MAOIs and increase risk of adrenal suppression with concurrent MAOI use, while isocarboxazid may increase corticosteroid effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and watch for signs of adrenal insufficiency; consider alternative ophthalmic therapy if feasible or ensure adequate patient monitoring during concurrent use.
